Package com.mimecast.robin.bots

Class BotRetrySpool

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.bots.BotRetrySpool
public final class BotRetrySpool extends Object
Keeps report bot endpoint requests that failed and sends them again later.

Each request is stored as one JSON file under <storage path>/bots/retry, so it survives an endpoint outage and a Robin restart. A single scheduled thread sends due requests, reschedules failures using RetryScheduler with the BotRetryConfig backoff, and moves requests that run out of retries, exceed the age limit, or are refused by the endpoint to bots/dead.

The endpoints receiving these reports are expected to deduplicate them, since a request that timed out may have been stored before it is sent again.

Only one thread processes the folder. Bot threads add new files concurrently, which is safe because each request has its own file and files are written atomically.
